raw_segments.text: Mr. Bloom turned, and saw the liveryed porter raise his lettered cap as a stately figure
entered between the newsboards of the weekly Freeman and National Press and the Freeman's
It passed stately up the staircase, steered by an umbrella, a solemn, beard-framed face.
The broadcloth back ascended each step back.
All his brains are in the nape of his neck, Simon Daedalus says, welts of flesh behind
Fat folds of neck, fat, neck, fat, neck.
